from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
def nm(X):
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((dv_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dv_dt), c

    def f(w):
        X=np.column_stack(cols(w)); return nm(X)[0]

    X=np.column_stack(cols(r.x)); e,c=nm(X)
    print(round(r.x,5),e)
    print(dict(zip(names,np.round(c,5))))
